voiceSummary: Elevate Campuses Limited has concluded its Earnings Conference Call on November 16, 2026. The call discussed Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The audio recording of the conference call is available on the company website.

attchmntText: Newspaper Publication of Financial Results for the quarter and half year endedSeptember 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Elevate Campuses Limited published newspaper extracts of its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on November 12, 2026. Consolidated total income was 167.13 lakhs for the quarter and 391.64 lakhs for the half year. Consolidated net loss after tax was 23.59 lakhs for the quarter and 6.20 lakhs for the half year. Earnings per share were negative 0.23 rupees for the quarter and positive 0.29 rupees for the half year. G-Tec Jainx Education Limited also reported results for the same period, approved on November 13, 2026. Standalone total income was 6,258.72 lakhs for the quarter and 12,728.00 lakhs for the half year. Standalone net profit was 106.46 lakhs for the quarter and 297.71 lakhs for the half year. Earnings per share were 0.12 rupees for the quarter and 0.33 rupees for the half year. Sundaram Multi Pap Limited reported standalone results approved on November 13, 2026. Total income was 2,963.33 lakhs for the quarter and 7,933.85 lakhs for the half year. Net loss after tax was 18.01 lakhs for the quarter and net profit was 13.80 lakhs for the half year. Earnings per share were zero for the quarter and 0.01 rupees for the half year. VIP Clothing Limited reported results approved on November 13, 2026. Total income was 6,258.72 lakhs for the quarter and 12,728.00 lakhs for the half year. Net profit was 106.46 lakhs for the quarter and 297.71 lakhs for the half year. Earnings per share were 0.12 rupees for the quarter and 0.33 rupees for the half year. Donear Industries Limited reported results approved on November 13, 2026. Total income was 30,666.83 lakhs for the quarter and 51,511.88 lakhs for the half year. Net profit after tax was 2,437.21 lakhs for the quarter and 3,566.13 lakhs for the half year. Earnings per share were 4.69 rupees for the quarter and 6.86 rupees for the half year.
